metadataAttributes.title: PM-2026-091: node disk pressure evicted pods after container logs filled the root volume
metadataAttributes.fix: Turned off the debug logging, set resources.limits.ephemeral-storage 2Gi and an emptyDir sizeLimit of 1Gi on the noisy container, and replaced the affected node. Clue: evictions of unrelated pods on one node with DiskPressure=True.
